MAT-DERM-HUMAN.name: Human Reticular Dermis (Baseline)
MAT-DERM-HUMAN.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: Baseline control tissue, low cut and puncture resistance against concentrated tools.

MAT-BOULIGAND-CHITIN.name: Bouligand Helicoidal Chitin-Apatite (Stomatopod Club)
MAT-BOULIGAND-CHITIN.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: Humans lack chitin synthase enzymes (CHS); pathway must be transgenically synthesized.
Arthropods rely on periodic ecdysis (molting) to replace worn appendages; continuous mammalian remodeling unproven.
Epitaxial mineralization requires marine-like carbonate/fluorapatite conditions.
Direct interface with vascularized mammalian dermis triggers severe foreign body reaction.

MAT-KERATIN-PANGOLIN.name: Cross-Lamellar Keratin Scale (Pangolin)
MAT-KERATIN-PANGOLIN.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: Extensive dermal keratinization blocks eccrine sweating, triggering severe hyperthermia during cursorial locomotion.
Slow biosynthesis (0.3-0.5 mm/month); recovery of damaged scale plates requires 60-120 days.
Hydration sensitivity: dry scales are hard but prone to brittle chipping; wet scales deform easily under sharp puncture.

MAT-OSTEODERM-ARMADILLO.name: Mineralized Dermal Osteoderm with Collagenous Sutures
MAT-OSTEODERM-ARMADILLO.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: Ectopic bone formation in humans mimics fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP), causing ankylosis and asphyxiation.
High acoustic impedance mismatch (Z ~ 6.5 MRayl vs tissue 1.6 MRayl) creates lethal tensile spallation upon ballistic shock.
Significant areal mass overhead (+12 to +15 kg) impairs locomotion acceleration and joint kinematics.

MAT-ENDOGENOUS-FGM.name: Continuous Hydroxyapatite-Collagen Gradient (FGM)
MAT-ENDOGENOUS-FGM.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: No known mammalian developmental program for stable 5 mm trans-epithelial mineral concentration gradients.
Calcium/phosphate systemic homeostasis risks ectopic vascular calcification and nephrolithiasis.
Remodeling of continuous gradient requires coordinated osteoblast/osteoclast synchronization without discrete lamellae.

MAT-BIOHYBRID-UHMWPE.name: Internal Biohybrid Porous UHMWPE-Collagen Ingrowth Mesh
MAT-BIOHYBRID-UHMWPE.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: Synthetic implant cannot self-repair; cumulative microstructural fatigue micro-voids require surgical explantation.
Sub-micron polymeric wear debris generation over years triggers chronic macrophage osteolysis.
Bacterial biofilm colonization risk if injured in non-sterile field conditions.

MAT-BIOHYBRID-CNT-PU.name: Carbon Nanotube / Segmented Polyurethane Fascial Sleeve
MAT-BIOHYBRID-CNT-PU.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: High aspect ratio CNTs induce asbestos-like granulomatous pleurisy/fibrosis if free fibers detach.
Fibrous capsule formation isolates the sleeve from functional myotendinous mechanotransduction.
Permanent synthetic fixture does not adapt to muscular hypertrophy or tissue atrophy.

MAT-SPEC-GRAPHENE-PROTEIN.name: Speculative Enzymatic Graphene-Chitin Biosynthetic Nanocomposite
MAT-SPEC-GRAPHENE-PROTEIN.ballistic_warning: Analytical Recht-Ipson surrogate. Not validated by physical range live-fire tests; does not prove weapon stopping capability.
translational_barriers: No known living enzyme or ribosome can synthesize covalent sp2 carbon sheets in an aqueous intracellular milieu.
Thermodynamic barrier: enzymatic dehydrogenation of hydrocarbons to pure graphene requires extreme energy inputs.
Cellular toxicity: intracellular graphene nano-sheets physically pierce lysosomal and mitochondrial membranes.
